* [[Hariru]] and [[Fraud]]'s battle continues.
* Fraud throws away his original [[Burst]] Heart and reveals a second one containing {{p|Reshiram}}.
* Back at the town, [[Ryouga]] senses the power Fraud exudes, which causes his {{p|Zekrom}} to react as well.
